kind: analyze (deterministic extraction of a curve from staged LOCPOTs)
provenance: values from 3_reproduction/L1/result.json and dVsl_vs_nu_ac.csv (run 20260530_li_L1_opus_think + nu_0.333 gap-fix 2026-06-11)
definition: dVsl = (top vacuum) minus (bottom vacuum) xy-planar-averaged potential offset, V; antisymmetric about nu_ac=1/2
sign_convention: levels are the values stored in LOCPOT, used as stored and not negated (VASP stores the potential energy of an electron). Stated in the prompt. The sibling units L3_analyze and L4_analyze grade the opposite reading, phi = -LOCPOT; a negated map scores 0 here on map_per_point.

grading.map_per_point: per-point tolerance tol_i = max(0.10*|truth_i|, 0.10*max|truth|) = max(0.10*|t|, 0.01321 V), i.e. 10% relative with a floor of 10% of the largest value; all 12 points within tol

antisymmetry.verified_from_submission: Every canonical periodic aligned pair, including self-pairs, must satisfy abs(pair sum) <= 0.10 * max(abs(aligned submitted steps)). The zero-map scale is zero.

extremum_consistency.rule: Reported extremum equals maximum absolute value in the full submitted map, allowing independent decimal reporting roundoff and a minimum 0.002 V arithmetic allowance.

grading.duplicate_consistency: Validate all periodic-equivalent coordinate pairs using 1e-12 coordinate roundoff tolerance, separate from the 0.02 sampling match band. All values in each duplicate group must be pairwise consistent under existing decimal reporting roundoff / 0.002 V allowance; input order cannot hide a conflict.

score: 1 only if all four primary checks pass (all checks must pass; any single failure scores 0)
